There is No Such Thing as Artists, Only Art Dealers

I appreciate that this article ends on a positive note. It seemed so down on what 'art' is these days, but the cynicism seems to be directed towards a very narrow slice of art, namely the collectors of extremely high priced masterworks. Those are always going to be treated like investments of commodity. But that does not say much about where art is going at the ground level. All art starts as something almost unknown, so by its very nature the well known masterpieces don't tell a current story.
